datasets.name: Operations
datasets.sql:
select
  op.rowID,op.*
from
  operations op
where
  schemaid = :schemaid
order by
  id

datasets.name: Operations_balance
datasets.sql:
select
   opb.rowid,opb.*
  ---,decode(typeid,1,'A',2,'P',3,'A-P','Unknown') as type
from
  operation_balances opb

where
  opb.operationid = :operationid
order by
   opb.balance
  ,opb.accno
  ,opb.accgroup
  ,opb.class

datasets.name: Report
datasets.sql:
select
  distinct
   op.schemaID
  ,opb.operationid
  ,bs.bal_cn
  ,decode(typeid,1,'A',2,'P',3,'A-P','Unknown') as type
  ,ar.acc_id
  ,ar.ostat as LastRest
  ,ar.pok_ostat as LastLRest
  ,ac.acc_no
  ,ac.val_acc
  ,ac.name 
  ,av.val_name
  ,op.operation
from
    archost ar
   ,operation_balances opb
   ,account ac
   ,operations op
   ,avalute av
   ,bal_spr1 bs
where
  ar.acc_id =  ac.id
   and ((ac.acc_no = opb.accno) or (bs.bal_cn = opb.balance) or (bs.accgroup = opb.accgroup) or (bs.part = opb.class))
   and ac.bal_cn1 = bs.bal_cn
   and op.id = opb.operationID
   and ac.val_acc = av.valute
   and ac.close_dat is null
   and (Sb_expertanalyse.checktipacc(opb.tipacc,ac.tipacc)=1)
   --line 29 + Branch Filter. Modified by TNariman '2-aug-2004'
   and ar.datdate =:OperationDate

order by
  opb.operationid ,bs.bal_cn,ac.acc_no

datasets.name: Traffics
datasets.sql:
select
  LastRemainder.bal_cn,
  LastRemainder.type,
  LastRemainder.acc_no,
  LastRemainder.val_acc,
  LastRemainder.name,
  LastRemainder.val_name,
  BeginRemainder.BeginRest,
  BeginRemainder.BeginLRest,
  TurnOvers.DebtTurnOver,
  TurnOvers.DebtPokTurnOver,
  TurnOvers.CreditTurnOver,
  TurnOvers.CreditPokTurnOver,
  LastRemainder.LastRest,
  LastRemainder.LastLRest
from

(select
  distinct
   opb.operationid
  ,ar.acc_id
  ,op.operation
  ,bs.bal_cn
  ,ac.acc_no
  ,ac.val_acc
  ,av.val_name
  ,decode(Sign(ar.ostat),-1,'A',1,'P',0,Decode(bs.typeid,1,'A',2,'P')) as type
  ,abs(ar.ostat) as BeginRest
  ,abs(ar.pok_ostat) as BeginLRest
  ,ac.name, opb.tipacc as btipacc, ac.tipacc as atipacc
from
    archost ar
   ,operation_balances opb
   ,account ac
   ,operations op
   ,avalute av
   ,bal_spr1 bs
where
  ar.acc_id =  ac.id
   and ((ac.acc_no = opb.accno) or (bs.bal_cn = opb.balance) or (bs.accgroup = opb.accgroup) or (bs.part = opb.class))
   and ac.bal_cn1 = bs.bal_cn
   and op.id = opb.operationID
   and ac.val_acc = av.valute
   and ac.close_dat is null
   and (op.ID =:operationID or opb.ID =:BalanceID)
   --line 45 + Branch Filter. Modified by TNariman '18-feb-2005'
   --and (Sb_expertanalyse.checktipacc(opb.tipacc,ac.tipacc)=1)
   and ar.datdate =:BeginPeriod
) BeginRemainder,

(select
  distinct
   ar.acc_id
  ,Sum(ar.obr_d) as DebtTurnOver
  ,Sum(ar.pok_obr_d) as DebtPokTurnOver
  ,Sum(ar.obr_k) as CreditTurnOver
  ,Sum(ar.pok_obr_k) as CreditPokTurnOver
from
    archost ar
   ,operation_balances opb
   ,account ac
   ,operations op
   ,avalute av
   ,bal_spr1 bs
where
  ar.acc_id =  ac.id
   and ((ac.acc_no = opb.accno) or (bs.bal_cn = opb.balance) or (bs.accgroup = opb.accgroup) or (bs.part = opb.class))
   and ac.bal_cn1 = bs.bal_cn
   and op.id = opb.operationID
   and ac.val_acc = av.valute
   and ac.close_dat is null
   and (op.ID =:operationID or opb.ID =:BalanceID)
   --line 72 + Branch Filter. Modified by TNariman '18-feb-2005'
   --and (Sb_expertanalyse.checktipacc(opb.tipacc,ac.tipacc)=1)
   and ar.datdate between :BeginDate and :LastDate
group by
   ar.acc_id
) TurnOvers,

(select
  distinct
   opb.operationid
  ,ar.acc_id
  ,op.operation
  ,bs.bal_cn
  ,ac.acc_no
  ,ac.val_acc
  ,av.val_name
  ,decode(Sign(ar.ostat),-1,'A',1,'P',0,Decode(bs.typeid,1,'A',2,'P')) as type
  ,abs(ar.ostat) as LastRest
  ,abs(ar.pok_ostat) as LastLRest
  ,ac.name, opb.tipacc as btipacc, ac.tipacc as atipacc
from
    archost ar
   ,operation_balances opb
   ,account ac
   ,operations op
   ,avalute av
   ,bal_spr1 bs
where
  ar.acc_id =  ac.id
   and ((ac.acc_no = opb.accno) or (bs.bal_cn = opb.balance) or (bs.accgroup = opb.accgroup) or (bs.part = opb.class))
   and ac.bal_cn1 = bs.bal_cn
   and op.id = opb.operationID
   and ac.val_acc = av.valute
   and ac.close_dat is null
   and (op.ID =:operationID or opb.ID =:BalanceID)
   --line 107 + Branch Filter. Modified by TNariman '18-feb-2005'
   --and (Sb_expertanalyse.checktipacc(opb.tipacc,ac.tipacc)=1)
   and ar.datdate =:LastDate
) LastRemainder

where
  BeginRemainder.Acc_ID (+) = LastRemainder.Acc_ID
  and
  LastRemainder.Acc_ID = TurnOvers.Acc_ID
  and
  (Sb_expertanalyse.checktipacc(LastRemainder.btipacc, LastRemainder.atipacc)=1)
order by
  LastRemainder.acc_no

datasets.name: Accounts

Select

from 
   Account

   close_dat is null

datasets.name: Balances

   bal_cn
  ,accgroup
  ,part
from
   bal_spr1

datasets.name: TotalTraffics
datasets.sql:
select
  ac.bal_cn1
 ,decode(bs.typeid,1,'A',2,'P',3,'A-P','Unknown')  as type
 ,abs(sum(ar.ostat)) as ostat
 ,abs(sum(ar.pok_ostat)) as pok_ostat
 ,sum(ar.obr_d) as DebtTurnOver
 ,sum(ar.pok_obr_d) as DebtPokTurnOver
 ,sum(ar.obr_k) as CreditTurnOver
 ,sum(ar.pok_obr_k) as CreditPokTurnOver
 ,max(bs.balname) as balname
from
  archost ar
 ,account ac
 ,bal_spr1 bs
 ,operations op
 ,operation_balances opb
where
  ar.acc_id = ac.ID
   and ac.bal_cn1 = bs.bal_cn
   and ((ac.acc_no = opb.accno) or (bs.bal_cn = opb.balance) or (bs.accgroup = opb.accgroup) or (bs.part = opb.class))
   and op.ID = operationID
   and ((op.ID =:operationID or opb.ID =:BalanceID or op.schemaID =:schemaID))
   and ar.datdate=:operationDate
   and ac.val_acc=%d
   and abs(ar.ostat)>=%f
   --line 26 + Branch Filter. Modified by TNariman '2-aug-2004'
   and (Sb_expertanalyse.checktipacc(opb.tipacc,ac.tipacc)=1)
group by
  ac.bal_cn1
 ,decode(bs.typeid,1,'A',2,'P',3,'A-P','Unknown') 
order by
  ac.bal_cn1

datasets.name: SchemaTraffics
datasets.sql:
select
  op.id
 ,abs(sum(ar.ostat)) as ostat
 ,abs(sum(ar.pok_ostat)) as pok_ostat
 ,sum(ar.obr_d) as DebtTurnOver
 ,sum(ar.pok_obr_d) as DebtPokTurnOver
 ,sum(ar.obr_k) as CreditTurnOver
 ,sum(ar.pok_obr_k) as CreditPokTurnOver
 ,max(op.operation) as operation
from
  archost ar
 ,account ac
 ,bal_spr1 bs
 ,operations op
 ,operation_balances opb
where
  ar.acc_id = ac.ID
   and ac.bal_cn1 = bs.bal_cn
   and ((ac.acc_no = opb.accno) or (bs.bal_cn = opb.balance) or (bs.accgroup = opb.accgroup) or (bs.part = opb.class))
   and op.ID = operationID
   and op.schemaID =:schemaID
   and ar.datdate =:operationDate
   and ac.val_acc=%d
   and abs(ar.ostat)>=%f
   --line 25 + Branch Filter. Modified by TNariman '2-aug-2004'
   and (Sb_expertanalyse.checktipacc(opb.tipacc,ac.tipacc)=1)

group by
  op.id

order by
  op.id
